sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: An omnichannel AI support platform — an earlier Muazaf project built around support automation: voice and chat agents, multiple communication channels, and knowledge-backed responses.
The product was developed but never commercially launched. After this work, the team stopped pursuing the standalone support-product direction and began the broader platform work that became Leen.

sections.title: Customer-support problem
paragraphs: Support teams needed consistent answers across channels without manually repeating the same information. Static FAQ pages and ad-hoc chatbots did not maintain context or draw on an organized knowledge base.
bullets: Inconsistent answers across voice, chat, and web touchpoints
Knowledge scattered across documents without reliable retrieval
Manual escalation when automated responses were insufficient

sections.title: What was built
paragraphs: A support-platform stack combining a structured knowledge base, agent-driven responses, and channel integrations for customer-facing interaction.
bullets: Voice and chat agents for customer-facing support
Knowledge base with retrieval for grounded responses
Multiple communication channels behind a shared support layer
Support-platform infrastructure connecting intake, retrieval, and response

sections.title: My contribution
paragraphs: Technical leadership across architecture, AI integration, and channel delivery. Scope included knowledge and retrieval design, integration boundaries, and engineering direction for the support stack.
Team members contributed to implementation. This case study does not claim solo delivery.

sections.title: Outcome and shift to Leen
paragraphs: The product was developed but not commercially launched. The team stopped pursuing the standalone support-product direction, and work shifted to a broader platform direction — what is now Leen.
Leen is not a renamed support product: the support platform was an earlier, narrower effort, while Leen became a broader AI operating environment direction.
